devices.sourceNotes: Exact source: data/tmp/tv/tv2.html. Remote: Bluetooth® 5.0 wireless technology; IR transmitter; USB-C connector for charging; rechargeable battery with months of battery life on a single charge (with typical daily usage); charging via USB-C to a computer system or power adapter (sold separately); controls TV or receiver via IR or CEC. Remote buttons: Back; Play/Pause; Mute; Power; Siri; TV/Home; Volume; USB-C. Video formats exact entries: SDR video with AVC/HEVC (Main/Main 10 profile) up to 2160p, 60 fps; Dolby Vision (Profile 5) up to 2160p, 60 fps; HDR10+/HDR10/HLG with HEVC (Main 10 Profile) up to 2160p, 60 fps; H.264 Baseline Profile level 3.0 or lower with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps per channel, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4 and .mov file formats; MPEG-4 video up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 fps, Simple profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4 and .mov file formats. Photo formats: HEIF, JPEG, GIF, TIFF. Electrical and environmental requirements exact text: Line voltage 100V to 240V AC; Frequency 50Hz to 60Hz; Operating temperature 0° to 35° C (32° to 95° F); Storage temperature -20° to 45° C (-4° to 113° F); Relative humidity 5% to 95% noncondensing; Operating altitude tested up to 3,000 metres (10,000 feet). Compatibility: Compatible with HD and UHD TVs with HDMI; Compatible with Bluetooth keyboards. In the Box: Apple TV 4K; Siri Remote; Power cord; Documentation. 39 unique image URLs are staged byte-for-byte in special-strict/images/apple-tv; the Open Graph URL appears both without and with an unchanged cache query and is recorded once by decoded filename. Isolated image manifest: special-strict/apple-tv.images.json. Contract loss caveat: CPU total is represented as minimum integer 1 because the source does not state a count but the shared schema requires a positive total. HDMI 2.1 and exact electrical/environmental wording are preserved in sourceNotes because the shared port-standard enum cannot represent HDMI 2.1.
